screenLevelGaps: ANSWER TO THE CUSTOMER'S CORE QUESTION (Command Center vs Library creation): they are NOT two disconnected stores. Both write the SAME table, s_users_skills. Command Center POSTs /competency/competencies -> CompetencyController::store (CompetencyController.php:97) and Library POSTs /skill_library/competency -> skillLibraryController::competencyLibraryStore (skillLibraryController.php:2517). A competency created in Command Center DOES appear in the Library table. The customer's suspicion of 'unconnected' is WRONG on storage. It is RIGHT on fields: the two forms are wildly divergent and the Command Center path silently discards data.

FIELD DIVERGENCE PROVEN. Command Center quick-create sends {name, category, competency_type, department_id, jobrole, status} (cm-command-center.tsx:217). Its backend validator accepts ONLY name, description, category, status, department_id (CompetencyController.php:81-87) and inserts only those (line 97-109). competency_type and jobrole are NOT validated, NOT inserted — SILENTLY DROPPED. The user picks 'Behavioural' in the Competency Type dropdown and nothing is stored. The Library form sends 15 fields and stores all of them.

STATUS VOCABULARY MISMATCH — the two creators disagree on what a status is. Command Center offers Published/Draft/Archived (cm-command-center.tsx:94-98); the backend maps 'published'->Approved and EVERYTHING ELSE->Pending (CompetencyController.php:104). So choosing 'Archived' in Command Center produces a PENDING competency, not an archived one. The Library uses Approved/Pending/Cancelled where Cancelled is displayed as 'Archived' (cm-competency-library.tsx:99-120). A Command-Center 'Archived' competency therefore shows as 'Pending' in the Library.

TYPE VOCABULARY MISMATCH. Command Center's COMPETENCY_TYPES are technical/behavioural/leadership/functional/core (cm-command-center.tsx:129-135). The Library's TYPE_VALUES are the KASA set Behavior/Skill/Ability/Attitude/Knowledge (cm-competency-library.tsx:87). Even if Command Center's value were saved it would never match the Library's Type filter or its Type column. Two competency taxonomies in one module.

CREATION FORM vs DRAWER TABS — CONFIRMED INCONSISTENT. The Library create form collects 15 fields. The drawer's Overview/Basic Information block (cm-competency-library.tsx:1394-1421) shows only 9: Name, Category, Type, Proficiency Scale, Description, Owner, Status, Created On, Last Updated. SUB CATEGORY and DEPARTMENT are collected by the form (lines 481, 492) and displayed NOWHERE in the drawer. The Attachments tab is built from exactly 5 of the 8 'Evidence & Resources' fields (skillLibraryController.php:2446-2452). The remaining 3 — Business Link (bussiness_links), Related Competencies (related_skills), Tags (custom_tags) — are stored and then never rendered by any tab. They are write-only dead data.

PROFICIENCY TAB CANNOT BE FED BY THE FORM. The form's 'Proficiency Scale' (line 499) is free text into s_users_skills.proficiency_level and surfaces only as the tab's `scale_label`. The actual level rows come from s_proficiency_levels (skillLibraryController.php:2331-2340), which this screen has no way to write — only StudioController does. So for a competency created here the Proficiency Levels tab shows either the tenant-wide global scale or 'No proficiency levels', regardless of what was typed in the form.

'CREATE ROLE MAPPING' IS A MISLABELLED FRAMEWORK CREATE — CONFIRMED DEFECT. QUICK_ACTIONS maps it to kind:'framework' (cm-command-center.tsx:56), which POSTs /competency/frameworks and inserts into s_competency_frameworks. No row is ever written to s_user_skill_jobrole. A real role-mapping API exists and is ignored: PUT /competency/role-mapping/cell -> RoleMappingController::upsertCell (routes/api.php:449). The user clicks 'Create Role Mapping', gets a framework, and the 'Job Roles Mapped' KPI does not move.

EVERY NAVIGATION TARGET IN COMMAND CENTER IS DEAD. go() pushes `/module/competency-management/${submenuId}/${submenuId}` with submenuId values like 'cm-competency-library' (cm-command-center.tsx:356). Routing resolves ONLY by real tblmenumaster_g2g access_link paths or numeric submenu ids (use-content-map.ts:32-38, content-map-m2.ts:22-33 where ids are '34','154','155','156','157','158'). CONTENT_MAP_LOADERS is keyed '1','2','3','4','5','204','186' — 'competency-management' is not a key (use-content-map.ts:6-15). parseRoutePath returns null for the fabricated path (use-sidebar-navigation.ts:152-155). Result: all 6 'View all' tile links, all 4 'View details' ring links, all 5 work-queue rows, 'View all work queues', 'View all activity' and 'View Calendar' land on the 'Application Shell Ready' placeholder. There is no rewrite in next.config.mjs.

THE LIBRARY DRAWER'S CROSS-MODULE LINKS ARE ALSO DEAD, VIA A SECOND WRONG SCHEME. openInSubmodule pushes `/module/m2/${submenuId}/${submenuId}?competency_id=…` (cm-competency-library.tsx:797). 'm2' is not a CONTENT_MAP_LOADERS key ('2' is). So 'Employees Rated', 'Development Plans', 'Certifications' and 'Learning Assigned' tiles all navigate to a placeholder. The same broken scheme is used by the Approval Queue's openSubject (audit/approval-queue.tsx:72) and cm-audit.tsx:319. Two screens invented two different, both-wrong URL builders.

WHERE IS ADMIN APPROVE/REJECT? It exists on the backend — PUT /api/competency/approvals/{id} with decision approve|reject, plus bulk-approve (ApprovalController.php:280-410) — and in ONE UI: components/domain/competency/audit/approval-queue.tsx, rendered as a tab inside Audit & Activity Center (cm-audit.tsx:626). It is absent from both screens in this unit. Worse, content-map-m2.ts:17-20 states in-code that the Audit & Activity Center menu (submenuId '208') has NO tblmenumaster_g2g row and therefore no access_link — meaning the only screen that can approve or reject a competency may not be reachable from the sidebar at all.

ROLE-BASED ACCESS CONTROL DOES NOT EXIST ANYWHERE IN THIS UNIT. ResolvesCompetencyContext (ResolvesCompetencyContext.php:28-40) resolves only sub_institute_id and user_id from the token — no profile/role/permission check. competencyLibraryContext (skillLibraryController.php:1649-1668) checks only that a token exists and sub_institute_id is numeric. Neither component reads a role: useAuth is used solely to build the Laravel context (cm-competency-library.tsx:665, 779). Consequence: any authenticated user in the tenant can create, edit, archive, clone, bulk-import, export the whole library, submit for approval, AND approve/reject their own submission. The spec's ADMIN row 'Role & permission management (who rates, approves, views)' (CompetencyManagementFeatures.txt:21-23) is unimplemented.

SELF-APPROVAL BYPASS. The Library edit form exposes a Status dropdown with Approved/Pending/Archived (cm-competency-library.tsx:501-506) which PUTs status straight to approve_status (skillLibraryController.php:2587-2589) with no reviewer, no queue row, no RBAC. The entire approval workflow is optional and one dropdown wide. Additionally, create defaults approve_status to 'Approved' server-side (line 2527) and the form deliberately omits Status on create (line 438) — so every new competency is born Approved with zero review.

REJECTED COMPETENCY IS A DEAD END. ApprovalController::store sets the competency to 'Pending' on submit (line 255-259). On reject it marks the approval row 'rejected' but leaves the competency at 'Pending' (line 316-332 — the subject is only touched when approving). The Library hides 'Submit for Approval' whenever status is Pending (cm-competency-library.tsx:1223). So a rejected competency can never be resubmitted from this screen; the only escape is the self-approval dropdown above.

RENAMING A COMPETENCY SILENTLY ORPHANS EVERY ROLE MAPPING. s_user_skill_jobrole stores the competency TITLE as a string, not an id (RoleMappingController.php:205, 224-235). competencyLibraryUpdate rewrites s_users_skills.title (skillLibraryController.php:2577) and touches nothing else. The drawer's Associations tab then queries where('skill', $skill->title) (skillLibraryController.php:2354) and returns zero. Edit the name of a mapped competency and its role mappings vanish from the UI while the orphan rows stay in the database.

THE KASA 'TYPE' NEVER REACHES THE MEASUREMENT STORE. s_users_skills.competency_type is read only by this Library (filter, column, form), the framework competency picker (FrameworkController.php:608) and the role-mapping picker (RoleMappingController.php:124). It is never written to or compared against s_skill_matrix.type ENUM('skill','knowledge','ability','attitude','behaviour') — the per-employee KASBA store. Note also the spelling clash: the UI stores 'Behavior', the matrix enum is 'behaviour'. Per the ownership model Competency DEFINES and MEASURES the KASBA dimension; here the definition side and the measurement side share no key.

DEPARTMENT IS STORED TWO INCOMPATIBLE WAYS BY THE TWO CREATORS. Command Center writes department_id (numeric, sourced from s_user_jobrole.department_id via the filters endpoint, CommandCenterService.php:343-353) and no name. The Library form writes the department NAME string only (cm-competency-library.tsx:492; department_id is never populated because the form has no such field). The Command Center's 'Total Competencies' tile filters on department_id (CommandCenterService.php:120-122), so a Library-created competency can NEVER match the Department filter, and a Command-Center-created competency shows a blank Department in the Library edit form.

NO LMS WRITE PATH FROM EITHER SCREEN. The drawer's 'Learning Assigned' tile only COUNTS lms_assignments where source='competency' (skillLibraryController.php:2435-2440); the rows are written by LearningAssignmentController from other screens. Neither screen offers 'Assign Course', and the Library's own 'Learning Resources' field is free text, not a course id. Per the ownership model Competency should hand a measured gap to LMS to BUILD the skill; that handoff does not originate here.

COMMAND CENTER 'Pending My Approvals' COUNTS THE WRONG QUEUE. CommandCenterService::workQueues counts s_competency_development_plans where approval_status='pending_approval' AND approver_id=me (CommandCenterService.php:215-221). It does not read s_competency_approvals at all, so competencies and frameworks awaiting review are invisible on the dashboard. Its click target is also 'cm-development-career' (cm-command-center.tsx:78) rather than the approval inbox — and that target is dead anyway.

QUICK-CREATED ASSESSMENTS / PLANS / CERTIFICATIONS HAVE NO EMPLOYEE. The dialog never collects user_id. AssessmentController::store inserts user_id NULL (AssessmentController.php:88); DevelopmentPlanController::store reads user_id_target ?: user_id, both absent (DevelopmentPlanController.php:414); CertificationController::store likewise (CertificationController.php:381). The assessment then surfaces in the Assessment Workspace's Participant Ratings tab as a row named 'Unknown' with role 'N/A' and campaign '—' (AssessmentCycleController.php:414-437) — and the TITLE the user typed is never displayed, because mapAssessment does not return it.

ARCHIVE/RESTORE LAUNDERS APPROVAL STATE. competencyLibraryArchive always restores to 'Approved' (skillLibraryController.php:2222-2223). Archive a Pending competency, restore it, and it is now Approved — a second approval bypass with no reviewer recorded.

SAVED VIEWS ARE BROWSER-LOCAL ONLY (localStorage key 'cm-competency-library:saved-views', cm-competency-library.tsx:303, 693-700). They do not survive a device change and cannot be shared with a team, which the code itself acknowledges at line 678-679. For a multi-tenant product sold to corporates this is a per-user preference masquerading as a configuration feature.

NO NOTIFICATION OR REMINDER ENGINE BEHIND ANY OF THIS. Prior verified ground truth: app/Events, app/Listeners, app/Observers do not exist. Submitting for approval, approving, rejecting, archiving and expiring certifications all write rows and notify nobody. The spec requires 'Notification/reminder engine for assessment cycles & deadlines' (CompetencyManagementFeatures.txt:35-36) and 'Notification center — approval pending alerts' (line 150).
